animals.name: Raven
dialogue: *Kraa! It ruffles its black feathers*

npcs.name: Commander Varek
dialogue: Ironhold Keep has stood for three centuries. I intend to see it stand for three more.
The patrol routes have been compromised. We need those reports.
You fight well, traveller. Ravenwatch is lucky to have you.

npcs.name: Guard-Master Doran
dialogue: Discipline wins sieges, not bravado. Drill, drill, and drill again.
Every soldier here answers to me before they answer to the Commander.
Stand a watch with us sometime, traveller. You'd learn something.

npcs.name: Blacksmith Kern
dialogue: Every blade that leaves my anvil could save a soldier's life.
The weapon crates haven't been accounted for since the last resupply.
Iron doesn't lie — only men do.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Sella
dialogue: Nothing enters or leaves these walls without crossing my ledger.
Grain, iron, arrows, salt — a castle eats as surely as it fights.
If you're after supplies, mind you sign for them.

npcs.name: Cook Mabel
dialogue: An army marches on its stomach, and this lot marches a long way.
Get out of my kitchen unless you're bringing me something to cook with.
There's stew on the hearth if the guards have left any.

npcs.name: Chaplain Aldwin
dialogue: Even iron men kneel before something, traveller.
The crypt below holds the lords of Ironhold, back to the first stone laid.
Light a candle for the fallen. There are always more of them than we'd like.

npcs.name: Archivist Elwyn
dialogue: The keep's records go back to the founding. Most of them, anyway.
A siege chronicle was separated from the archives. It belongs here.
History is the only weapon that never dulls.

npcs.name: Stablehand Pip
dialogue: The destriers know me better than my own mother does.
Mind where you step — a war horse spooks at less than you'd think.
If you ride out, I'll have a mount saddled before you reach the gate.

npcs.name: Sir Garrick
dialogue: I have held this wall through two winters and a siege. I'll hold it through more.
A knight without a cause is just a man in expensive metal.
The Guard-Master sets the rotation. Take it up with him.

npcs.name: Squire Tomas
dialogue: One day I'll be a knight. For now I muck out stalls and polish armour.
Sir Garrick says I've a good arm. He says it rarely, mind.
I dropped a training sword somewhere out here. Don't tell the Guard-Master.

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Olen
dialogue: The portcullis hasn't jammed on my watch and it never will.
State your business at the gate or state it elsewhere.
Safe roads, traveller. The world beyond these walls is less forgiving.

npcs.name: The Prisoner
dialogue: Psst. Over here. They've left me to rot for a crime I never committed.
I know things about this keep that would turn the Commander's beard white.
Help me prove my innocence and the secret of the lower vault is yours.

npcs.name: Guard Bren
dialogue: Patrol routes are memorised, not written. Or they used to be.
Three of us dropped our patrol papers during the last drill. Embarrassing.
The south gate is yours to use, traveller.

npcs.name: Guard Holt
dialogue: All quiet on the eastern wall.
I lost my patrol report somewhere out in the courtyard. The Commander will have my head.
Ironhold has never fallen. Long may that last.

reactions.text: A scrappy bush growing wild in the Outer Bailey.
A patch of wildflowers, somehow thriving between the flagstones.
A shaded bush near the dungeon wall, worth a closer look.
Tucked into a crack in the west wall's old stonework, something small has been wedged there for ages.

collectible.name: Tarnished Watch Token
collectible.desc: A brass token stamped with the keep's old watch rotation mark.
collectible.lore: Guard-Master Doran would recognize the mark — this rotation was retired decades ago, back when the west wall still had a name of its own.

reactions.message: You found an old watch token.

reactions.text: Scratched into a flagstone near the gatehouse tunnel, a tally mark series is barely visible under the dust.

collectible.name: Scratched Tally Stone
collectible.desc: A flagstone fragment scored with dozens of tally marks.
collectible.lore: Gatekeeper Olen keeps his own count of every watch he's stood. This isn't his hand — someone else was counting something here, a long time before him.

reactions.message: You found a stone scratched with old tally marks.

reactions.text: Half-buried near the old drill yard, a heavy iron key is nearly rusted through.

collectible.name: Rusted Iron Key
collectible.desc: A heavy iron key, its teeth worn nearly smooth with rust.
collectible.lore: Archivist Elwyn might know what it opens — the scriptorium's old ledgers mention a lower vault whose key was 'lost to the drill yard' generations back.

reactions.message: You found a rusted iron key. The scriptorium's records might explain what it opens.

reactions.text: Behind the rubble the rusted key seemed to point toward, a small chest sits wedged against the boulevard wall.

collectible.name: Lower Vault Relic
collectible.desc: A small strongbox, its lock long since sprung.
collectible.lore: Whatever the scriptorium's ledgers meant by 'the lower vault,' this might be all that's left of it. Archivist Elwyn would want to see this.

reactions.message: You found a relic from the lower vault!
